basis: Mixed sources: live app captures from a seeded demo shop for inventory and finance, plus earlier illustrative local dashboard and mobile views. No real-customer adoption claim.
captureMethod: Headless Chrome against a local Next.js server. API requests intercepted with synthetic responses. No backend or production write requests.

liveCaptures.accountBasis: User-authorized seeded shop account. Credentials and browser session were not saved.
liveCaptures.method: Headless Chrome with a fresh browser context. Screenshots use native browser clipping with surrounding space. No mocked responses, restyled numbers or generated UI.
liveCaptures.actions: Signed in and opened existing pages. Did not create business transactions, run matching or treasury, approve actions, accept offers, start a simulator or make an explicit paid AI call. Page reads can refresh normal analytics records.
liveCaptures.limitations: Matching shows saved offer blockers. Saved insights and alerts may reflect earlier shop snapshots. Screenshots do not prove causal benefit or current affordability.

imageUse: Product walkthrough only. Benchmark chart and paired-result table use the separately saved evidence reports. Original local capture metadata above applies only to the earlier captures list.
